sources.snippet: The goal of this project is to reduce the amount of manual work needed to review and route support tickets. Instead of relying only on humans or keyword-based rules, the model analyzes the text of a support ticket and predicts which department should handle it. The dataset contains customer support tickets across 10 different support queues.
